name: source-code-uploader
description: A Chrome extension that uploads accepted solutions from algorithm judge sites to GitHub and Notion.

scripts.lint: eslint scripts popup tests proxy tools eslint.config.js eslint.airbnb-rules.js --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:fix: eslint scripts popup tests proxy tools eslint.config.js eslint.airbnb-rules.js --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write "*.md" docs .github scripts popup tests proxy tools eslint.config.js eslint.airbnb-rules.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "*.md" docs .github scripts popup tests proxy tools eslint.config.js eslint.airbnb-rules.js
